# OptimalRepresentation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A coding scheme that maximizes information fidelity and discriminability under resource constraints, often achieved near criticality. Informs how interconnect topologies and in-network processing can be optimized for high-dimensional data representation in TCC/iNEST systems.
